# Yooka-Replaylee

This APWorld currently randomizes the Yooka-Replaylee location list and movement abilities.

The current generation baseline uses a connected region graph with no entrance or individual location requirements yet. The final goal is represented by a generation-only `Victory` event in Galleon Galaxy.


## Triple Pagie Medal Goal

The `goal` option accepts a value from 1 to 10. Each of the five boss checks and each of the five `Grand Tome Ghosts` checks awards a `Triple Pagie Medal`. The completion condition is reaching the configured number of medals.


## Quillsanity

When enabled, the seed includes all 750 individual Quill checks. When disabled, those checks are omitted.

tutorials.text:
# Yooka-Replaylee Randomizer Setup Guide

## Installing the APWorld

Install the generated `.apworld` through the Archipelago Launcher.

## Generating a seed

Select `Yooka-Replaylee` as the game in your Archipelago YAML and run the normal Archipelago generator.

This APWorld currently has no custom player options.

## Client status

This package currently contains the generation-side APWorld only. A Yooka-Replaylee game client/connector is not included yet.

notes.text:
I hope you enjoy my first apworld of Yooka-Replaylee

There are 3 goal settings currently:

-defeat_capital_b: Collect 1-300  Capital Keys (choose amount to goal and amount in pool in settings) to gain access to Capital B's office and take back the one book!

-golden_pagie_hunt: The equivalent of a triforce hunt, once you've received your goal amount of golden pagies, your goal will be sent!

-triple_pagie_medal_hunt: Collect triple pagie checks to get triple pagie medals! This includes the 5 bosses and the grand tome ghosts!



Features and what's included:

-Death Link (Toggleable!)
-Quillsanity which adds 785 checks to the pool
-Checks for every casino token, every trowzer shop, every pagie piece, and (ALMOST) every pagie! (Some are still buggy and being investigated)


Known Bugs:
- When a progressive pagie door item is sent and you are in hivory towers, make sure to pause save and quit when the cutscene pops up, this is a temporary work around to avoid freezes and to prevent messed up logic. 

- When a player dies in a rextro minigame or loading screen with death link on, this can sometimes freeze the game, this is being investigated.

- Once in a while randomly the game will turn all the pagies transparent which makes certain pagies think they were already collected, making certain checks unobtainable. If this happens, reboot the game to fix it.

- When the game is rebooted, pagie door cutscenes will play in the hubs again. (This is a failsafe to prevent pagie doors being perma-locked if a file gets lost) Simply save and quit like you would the normal pagie doors when this happens.
